DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 園内の案内図をご覧ですか。今日はどの辺りを歩くご予定でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking at the park map? Which area are you planning to walk around today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 池を一周したかったのですが、空が暗くなってきました。入口へ早めに戻れる短い道はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夕暮れを理由に池一周から入口へ早く戻れる短い道へ変更したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wanted to walk around the pond, but the sky is getting dark. Is there a short route that gets me back to the entrance sooner?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to change from walking around the pond to a short route back to the entrance because dusk is approaching. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 池の一周はやめて、この中央の広場まで往復する道はいかがですか。分かれ道で池側へ入らずに戻れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Instead of going around the pond, how about walking to this central plaza and back? You can return without taking the pond-side path at the fork.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この道には坂や階段がありますか。今日は重い荷物を持っていて、階段を避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 重い荷物を持つため提案道の坂と階段の有無を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Does that route have slopes or stairs? I'm carrying heavy luggage today and want to avoid stairs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether the suggested route has slopes or stairs because you are carrying heavy luggage. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 案内図で示した広場までの道には階段はありません。ただ、少し上り坂になっています。荷物がつらければ入口近くで休むこともできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: The route to the plaza shown on the map has no stairs, but it does go slightly uphill. If carrying your luggage is difficult, you can also rest near the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: それなら広場へ行くのもやめます。入口の近くで座れる場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 広場への往復もやめ入口近くの着席場所を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: In that case, I won't go to the plaza either. Please tell me where I can sit near the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decide against the round trip to the plaza too and ask for somewhere to sit near the entrance. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 案内所の裏に長椅子があります。通路をふさがないよう、荷物はお手元に置いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: There are benches behind the information office. Please keep your luggage with you so it doesn't block the walkway.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 裏の長椅子で休みます。そこから帰るとき、駐車場側ではなくバス停側の出口へ行きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 案内所裏で休むと答え帰路はバス停側出口を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll rest on a bench behind the office. When I leave from there, I'd like to use the exit toward the bus stop rather than the parking lot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll rest behind the information office and want to leave through the exit toward the bus stop. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 休憩後は案内所の前へ戻り、白い出口表示に沿って進んでください。駐車場の表示とは反対側です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: After resting, return to the front of the information office and follow the white exit signs. They're in the opposite direction from the parking lot signs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: いったん案内所の前へ戻って、白い出口表示を探します。今日は遠くまで歩かず、休んでから帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内所前に戻り白い出口表示を探し遠出せず休憩後に帰ると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll first return to the front of the office and look for the white exit signs. I won't walk far today; I'll rest and then go home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm you'll return to the front of the information office, look for white exit signs, avoid going far, and go home after resting. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ええ、足元とお荷物に気をつけてお帰りください。また明るい時間にお越しください。さようなら。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34210-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, watch your step and take care with your luggage on your way home. Please visit again when it's light. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その大きなお荷物、階段では大変ですね。どのホームへ行かれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: That large bag must be difficult on the stairs. Which platform are you going to?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 一番ホームに行きたいです。このケースが重くて持ち上げられないので、エレベーターを使いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一番ホームへ重いケースを持って行くためエレベーターを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to go to Platform 1. This case is too heavy for me to lift, so I'd like to use the elevator.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want an elevator to take your heavy case to Platform 1. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 一番ホーム行きのエレベーターは改札の中にあります。こちらの改札は通路が狭いので、隣の広い改札へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The elevator to Platform 1 is inside the ticket gates. This gate has a narrow passage, so please use the wider gate next to it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 隣の改札を使います。切符を入れたあと、ケースだけ先に通しても大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 広い改札を選び切符投入後にケースを先に通す方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll use the gate next to it. After inserting my ticket, is it okay to send just the case through first?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose the wide gate and ask about sending your case through first after inserting your ticket. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 切符を取り忘れないようにして、ケースを押しながら一緒にお通りください。お手伝いしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please go through together while pushing the case, and don't forget to collect your ticket. Would you like some help?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分で押せますので大丈夫です。改札を通った先では、どちらへ進めばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 介助を断り自力で押せると伝えて改札通過後の方向を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'm fine; I can push it myself. Which way should I go after passing through the gate?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Decline assistance, say you can push it yourself, and ask which way to go after the gate. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 改札を通ったら右です。ただし左のエレベーターは別のホーム行きなので、一番ホームの表示を確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Turn right after the gate. The elevator on the left goes to a different platform, so please check the Platform 1 signs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 右へ進み、一番ホームの表示を見ます。エレベーターを降りてから、まだ階段がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 右側の一番ホーム表示を確認すると伝え降りた先の階段の有無を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll go right and check the Platform 1 sign. Are there still stairs after I get out of the elevator?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll check the Platform 1 sign on the right and ask whether there are stairs after leaving the elevator. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありません。同じ高さの通路でホームへ出られます。工事の柵がありますので、その手前の通路をお使いください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: No. You can reach the platform along a level passage. There is a construction barrier, so please use the passage before you reach it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 階段はないんですね。柵の手前を通ります。列車に急いで乗ろうとせず、ケースを押してゆっくり進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 工事柵手前の経路を使い急がずケースを押して進むと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: So there aren't any stairs. I'll take the passage before the barrier. I won't rush to catch the train; I'll push my case and move slowly.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm you'll use the route before the construction barrier and push your case along without rushing. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、時間に余裕を持ってお進みください。それでは、お気をつけていってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, please allow plenty of time as you go. Have a safe journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本日のご用件を伺ってもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I ask what you need help with today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 先週この市に引っ越しました。住所を変える手続きをしたいのですが、最初の窓口はどこですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 先週転入したことを伝え住所変更の最初の窓口を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I moved to this city last week. I'd like to change my registered address. Which counter should I go to first?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you moved here last week and ask for the first counter for changing your address. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 住民登録の窓口でご相談ください。ご本人の届出ですか、それともご家族の分もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please consult the resident registration counter. Is the notification just for you, or for your family too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私一人の分です。前の市から受け取った封筒がありますが、何が入っているかまだ確認していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本人一人の届出と伝え前住所地の封筒の中身が未確認だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's just for me. I have an envelope from my previous city, but I haven't checked what's inside yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the notification is only for you and explain you haven't checked the contents of the envelope from your previous municipality. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ここで一緒に中身を確認しましょう。転出に関する書類が一枚ありますね。身分を確認できるものはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the contents together here. There's one document relating to moving out. Do you have anything to verify your identity?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 在留カードとパスポートを持っています。マイナンバーカードは家に置いてきてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 在留カードとパスポートを持参しマイナンバーカードを忘れたと申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have my residence card and passport. I left my My Number Card at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you brought your residence card and passport but forgot your My Number Card. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お持ちの書類と、そのカードを忘れたことを担当にお伝えください。今日どこまで手続きできるかは、担当が状況を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tell the person in charge which documents you have and that you forgot that card. They'll check your circumstances to see how much of the process can be completed today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: カードを忘れたことも伝えます。転入届は先に書いたほうがいいですか。住所の書き方に自信がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 忘れたカードを担当へ申告すると伝え住所記入支援と記入開始の時点を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll tell them I forgot the card too. Should I fill in the moving-in notification first? I'm not confident about how to write the address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll tell the person in charge about the forgotten card, and ask for help writing your address and when to start filling in the form. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 新住所を確認できるメモなどがあれば、窓口で見せてください。記入を手伝ってもらえるよう案内票に書いておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you have a note or something that confirms your new address, please show it at the counter. I'll note on the referral slip that you'd like help filling in the form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 賃貸契約書に新住所が載っています。それを見せて、部屋番号まで確認してから書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 賃貸契約書を示し部屋番号まで確認して転入届を書くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: My new address is on my rental agreement. I'll show that and check everything down to the room number before writing it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you'll show your rental agreement, check the address including the room number, and then fill in the moving-in notification. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 案内票をお渡しします。住民登録の窓口で番号をお待ちください。それでは、よろしくお願いいたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here's your referral slip. Please wait for your number at the resident registration counter. Thank you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 診察のご予約についてご相談ですね。お名前と現在の予約日を伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like to discuss your medical appointment, correct? May I have your name and current appointment date?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 田中です。木曜日の十時に予約していますが、仕事の研修と重なったので変更したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 名前と木曜十時の予約を伝え研修による変更希望を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm Tanaka. My appointment is at ten on Thursday, but it overlaps with training at work, so I'd like to change it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Give your name and Thursday ten o'clock appointment and explain you want to change it because of training. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約を確認できました。変更前に、前回から症状に変化がないか伺います。今、困っている症状はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I've found your appointment. Before changing it, I'd like to ask whether your symptoms have changed since your last visit. Do you have any symptoms troubling you now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 前回と変わりません。薬はまだありますが、来週まで足りるかは確認できていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 症状が変わらないと伝え薬が来週まで足りるか未確認だと申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: They haven't changed since last time. I still have medicine, but I haven't checked whether it will last until next week.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say your symptoms haven't changed and you haven't checked whether your medicine will last until next week. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では残りの薬を確認しましょう。診察券と一緒に薬の袋もお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let's check your remaining medicine. Do you have the medicine bag as well as your patient card?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい、この袋です。家に残っている分も含めて、昨日数えたメモはあります。見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 薬袋と前日作成の残薬メモを提示して確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes, here's the bag. I also have a note of the amount I counted yesterday, including what's left at home. Could you look at it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show your medicine bag and the note you made yesterday of your remaining medicine, and ask for a check. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 拝見します。服用日数の確認が必要なので、予約担当だけでなく診療側にも確認します。変更したい曜日はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll take a look. We need to check how many days your medicine covers, so I'll ask the clinical staff as well as the appointment staff. Is there a day you'd prefer to change to?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 来週の月曜日の午後なら休めます。難しければ、今の木曜日の予約を残しておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 月曜午後を希望し変更不可なら元の予約を維持してほしいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I can take next Monday afternoon off. If that's difficult, please keep my current Thursday appointment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request Monday afternoon and ask to keep the original appointment if the change isn't possible. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認したところ、月曜日の十五時に変更できます。薬のことで追加確認が必要ならこちらから連絡します。この日時でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I've checked, and we can change it to three on Monday afternoon. We'll contact you if we need any further information about your medicine. Is that time okay?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 月曜日の十五時でお願いします。確認の連絡はこの携帯番号にください。日時を手帳にも書きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 月曜十五時を選び追加確認の連絡先と手帳への記録を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Three on Monday afternoon, please. Please call this mobile number for any further checks. I've also written the date and time in my planner.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose Monday at three, give a contact number for further checks, and say you've recorded it in your planner. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 木曜日の予約を取り消し、月曜日の十五時へ変更しました。症状が変わったときは予定を待たずにご連絡ください。それでは、お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've canceled Thursday's appointment and changed it to three on Monday. If your symptoms change, contact us without waiting for the appointment. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車が見当たらないとのことですね。最後に確認したのはいつ、どこですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your bicycle is missing, correct? When and where did you last see it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日の夜八時ごろ、駅の南側の駐輪場に停めました。今朝取りに行ったら、その場所にありませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 最後に停めた日時と駅南側の駐輪場を伝え今朝見当たらなかったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I parked it in the bicycle parking area south of the station at about eight last night. When I went to collect it this morning, it wasn't there.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Give the date, time, and bicycle parking area south of the station where you last parked it, and explain it was missing this morning. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 周りの列も探しましたか。移動や撤去の案内が掲示されていなかったかも教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Did you search the surrounding rows too? Please also tell me whether any notices about relocation or removal were posted.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 隣の三列も見ました。撤去の案内は気づきませんでしたが、奥の掲示板までは見ていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 周辺の探索範囲と掲示板が未確認であることを伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I checked the three neighboring rows too. I didn't notice a removal notice, but I haven't looked at the noticeboard at the back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say how far you searched nearby and that you haven't checked the noticeboard. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 未確認の掲示があるのですね。車体を識別するため、色、形、目立つ特徴を伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: So there are notices you haven't checked. To identify the bicycle, I'd like its color, shape, and distinctive features.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 紺色の自転車で、前に黒いかごがあります。後ろの泥よけに白い星のシールを貼っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 紺色と黒いかごと白い星シールを車体の特徴として説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's navy blue, with a black basket at the front. There's a white star sticker on the rear mudguard.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the navy color, black basket, and white star sticker as identifying features of the bicycle. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。防犯登録の控えや車体番号がわかる書類はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Thank you. Do you have your bicycle security registration copy or a document showing the frame number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 登録の控えは家にあります。購入時の写真なら携帯にあるので、今お見せできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 登録控えが自宅にあると伝え購入時の写真を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: The registration copy is at home. I have a photo from when I bought it on my phone, so I can show you that now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say your registration copy is at home and show a photo taken when you bought the bicycle. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 写真を確認します。控えはあとで持参できるよう探しておいてください。鍵をかけたか、同じ自転車を使う方がいるかも確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll check the photo. Please find the copy so you can bring it later. We'll also check whether you locked it and whether anyone else uses the same bicycle.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 後輪の鍵をかけました。私しか使いません。登録の控えを探し、駐輪場の掲示も確認して結果をお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 後輪施錠と単独使用を説明し控えと掲示を確認して報告する方針を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I locked the rear wheel. Only I use it. I'll find the registration copy, check the parking area's notices, and tell you the results.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain you locked the rear wheel and are the only user, and say you'll check the registration copy and notices and report back. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。ここまでの内容を記録しましたので、控えと確認結果を持ってご相談ください。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I've recorded what you've told me so far, so please come back with the copy and your findings. Get home safely.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの封筒をお送りになる予定ですか。中身を伺ってもよろしいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you planning to send this envelope? May I ask what's inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 署名した契約書です。届いたか確かめたいのですが、追跡できれば相手が受け取った証明にもなりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 署名済み契約書を送ると伝え追跡が受領証明にもなるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's a signed contract. I'd like to check that it arrives. If I can track it, does that also prove the recipient received it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you're sending a signed contract and ask whether tracking also counts as proof of receipt. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 配送状況を調べることと、受領について記録を残すことは別です。相手から送り方を指定されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Checking delivery progress and retaining a record of receipt are different things. Has the recipient specified a shipping method?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 案内には「受領を確認できる方法」とあります。どのサービス名かは書いてありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受領を確認できる方法という指定のみでサービス名がないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The instructions say, “a method that allows receipt to be confirmed.” They don't give a service name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that only a method allowing receipt to be confirmed is specified, without a service name. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その文言だけでは相手が必要とする記録が決まりません。契約書の担当者に、何を提出すればよいか確認されると確実です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: That wording alone doesn't establish what record they need. It's best to ask the person handling the contract what you need to submit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、今日は発送を待ちます。担当者に聞くために、追跡と受領の記録の違いをもう一度教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発送を保留し追跡と受領記録の違いを再説明してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll hold off on sending it today. To help me ask them, please explain the difference between tracking and a record of receipt again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Put shipment on hold and ask for another explanation of tracking versus a record of receipt. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 追跡は主に配送の進み具合を確認するものです。受領の記録は、どんな形で誰の受取りを示せるかが大事になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Tracking mainly lets you check how delivery is progressing. With a record of receipt, what matters is whose receipt of the item it can establish and in what form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 相手には、必要な記録の形と、使うサービス名を確認します。封筒の宛先も担当者名まで書いたほうがいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 必要な記録形式とサービス名を相手に聞くと伝え宛名の担当者記載を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll ask the recipient about the required form of record and the service name to use. Should I also include the person's name in the address on the envelope?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll ask the recipient about the required record format and service name, and ask about including the contact person's name in the address. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 担当者宛てなら部署名と担当者名を確認して書くとよいでしょう。宛先の案内をご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: If it's addressed to that person, it's a good idea to confirm and write the department and person's name. Would you like to look at the address instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: メールの案内を見直します。部署名はありますが担当者名はないので、それも問い合わせてから持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: メールに部署名のみあると確認し担当者名も問い合わせて再来店すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll reread the email instructions. They include the department but no person's name, so I'll ask about that too before bringing it back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the email only lists the department and say you'll ask for the contact person's name too before returning. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、指定内容がわかったら一緒に送り方を選びましょう。封筒をお返しします。それでは、またお待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, once you know the requirements, let's choose a shipping method together. Here's your envelope back. We look forward to seeing you again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 口座開設のご相談ですね。口座は何のためにお使いになる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You'd like to discuss opening an account, correct? What do you plan to use it for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社の給料を受け取るためです。来日して二か月なので、私の状況で申し込めるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 給与受取目的と来日二か月を伝え申込み可能か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: To receive my salary from my company. I arrived in Japan two months ago, so I'd like to know if I can apply in my circumstances.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say the account is for salary payments and you arrived in Japan two months ago, and ask whether you can apply. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 在留状況やお仕事などを確認してからご案内します。現在のお勤め先を確認できる資料はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll advise you after checking your residence status, employment, and other details. Do you have documents confirming your current employer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 雇用契約書はあります。社員証はまだできていません。在留カードとパスポートも持っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 雇用契約書と本人資料を持参し社員証未発行と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have my employment contract. My employee ID hasn't been issued yet. I also have my residence card and passport.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you brought an employment contract and identity documents, and explain your employee ID hasn't been issued. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、こちらの担当が確認します。給与の振込先について、会社から銀行や支店の指定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then this staff member will check them. Has your company specified a bank or branch for salary payments?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: この銀行を指定されていますが、支店は自由だそうです。契約書の名前がカタカナだけなのが気になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 銀行指定と支店自由を伝え契約書のカタカナ氏名表記への懸念を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: They've specified this bank, but say I can choose any branch. I'm concerned that my name on the contract is only in katakana.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that the bank is specified but the branch is your choice, and raise your concern about the katakana name on your contract. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 本人確認書類との表記の対応も確認する必要があります。ここで勝手に名前を書き換えず、会社の登録内容を確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We also need to check how that spelling corresponds to your identity documents. Rather than changing the name here yourself, let's check your company's registered details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 会社に、給与振込に使う氏名の表記を確認します。今ある書類で、ほかに足りないものも教えてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 会社へ振込用氏名を確認すると伝え不足資料の案内を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll ask my company how my name should be written for salary payments. Could you also tell me what else is missing from the documents I have now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll check the name for salary payments with your company and ask what documents are missing. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お持ちの書類を担当が見て、追加で必要な資料を案内します。申込みができるかと、口座が開設されるかは別の確認になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will look at your documents and explain any additional documents needed. Whether you can apply and whether an account will be opened are separate checks.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 審査結果はまだ決まらないんですね。まず書類を確認していただき、足りない資料の名前をメモしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 開設結果は未定と理解して書類確認と不足資料のメモを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: So the review result hasn't been decided yet. I'd first like you to check my documents and let me note the names of any missing ones.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show you understand that account opening is undecided and ask for a document check and to note any missing documents. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、開設担当へご案内します。書類はお手元にお持ちください。それでは、担当席でよろしくお願いいたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, I'll take you to the account-opening staff. Please keep your documents with you. You can continue with the person at their desk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計の前に、価格で気になる点がありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before you pay, was there something about the price you wanted to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この豆腐は棚で九十八円と見たのに、レジでは百四十八円でした。同じ商品の値段でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 棚の九十八円とレジ百四十八円の差を伝え同じ商品か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I saw this tofu marked 98 yen on the shelf, but it came up as 148 yen at the register. Are those prices for the same product?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the difference between the 98 yen shelf price and 148 yen register price, and check whether they're the same product. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 商品の表示を確認します。お持ちなのは三百グラムですね。棚の札も見てまいります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check the product label. Yours is 300 grams. I'll go and check the shelf label too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 札には百五十グラムと書いてあったかもしれません。棚の手前にこの大きい豆腐があったので、同じものだと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 札の重量を見落とした可能性と棚手前の商品で誤認した経緯を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The label may have said 150 grams. This larger tofu was at the front of the shelf, so I thought it was the same item.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you may have missed the label's weight and mistook the product because of its position at the front of the shelf. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認できました。九十八円は百五十グラムのほうで、こちらは百四十八円です。棚の手前の商品を正しい列へ戻しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: I've checked. The 150-gram one is 98 yen, and this one is 148 yen. I've put the item at the front back into the correct row.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: サイズが違ったんですね。今日は一人分だけなので、九十八円の小さいほうに替えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 重量の違いを理解し一人分として小さい九十八円の商品への交換を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: So they're different sizes. I only need one person's portion today, so I'd like to switch to the smaller 98 yen one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Acknowledge the weight difference and ask to switch to the smaller 98 yen item for one person's portion. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 交換できます。小さい商品をこちらへお持ちしました。表示を一緒に確かめていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can switch. I've brought the smaller one here. Could you check the label with me?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 百五十グラムで合っています。九十八円は税込みの金額ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 百五十グラムを確認して九十八円が税込みか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, 150 grams is right. Does the 98 yen price include tax?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm it's 150 grams and ask whether 98 yen includes tax. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、税込み九十八円です。大きいほうを会計から取り消して、小さいほうに変更しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, it's 98 yen including tax. I've removed the large one from your bill and replaced it with the smaller one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 変更を確認しました。小さい豆腐一つだけを買います。電子マネーで払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会計変更を確認し小さい豆腐一つを電子マネーで支払う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've checked the change. I'll buy just one small tofu. I'll pay with electronic money.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the bill change and pay for one small tofu with electronic money. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 九十八円のお支払いが済みました。こちらが商品とレシートです。ご確認いただき、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Your payment of 98 yen is complete. Here are your item and receipt. Thank you for checking with us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 園内の案内図をご覧ですか。歩きたい場所がお決まりでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking at the park map? Have you decided where you'd like to walk?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 父と池を見たいのですが、今日はあまり長く歩けません。入口から近い道を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 父と池を見たいが長距離は歩けないと伝え入口から近い経路を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to see the pond with my father, but we can't walk very far today. Please tell me a route that's close to the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you'd like to see the pond with your father but can't walk far, and ask for a short route from the entrance. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 池の南側までなら、平らな道で片道五分ほどです。一周すると坂もあり、二十分ほどかかります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: It's about five minutes one way to the south side of the pond along a flat path. A full circuit has slopes and takes about twenty minutes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一周はやめて南側までにします。途中に座れる場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 池一周をやめ南側への往復を選び途中の座れる場所を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: We won't go all the way around; we'll just go to the south side. Is there somewhere to sit along the way?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose a round trip to the pond's south side instead of a full circuit and ask for places to sit on the way. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 途中の花壇の横にベンチがあります。池の前にもありますが、そちらは今、日差しが強いです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: There's a bench beside the flower bed on the way. There's one in front of the pond too, but it's in strong sunlight right now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 父が疲れたら、花壇の横で休みます。戻るときに別の近道を使えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 花壇での休憩を選び帰路に近道を使えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: If my father gets tired, we'll rest beside the flower bed. Can we take a different shortcut on the way back?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose to rest at the flower bed and ask whether you can use a shortcut back. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 管理用通路は近く見えますが、来園者は通れません。入口へは、来た平らな道を戻るのが短いです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: The maintenance path looks shorter, but visitors can't use it. The shortest way back to the entrance is along the flat path you came on.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 管理用通路には入らず、同じ道を戻ります。帰る前にトイレへ寄りたいのですが、入口のそばにありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 管理通路を避け同じ道で戻ると確認し入口付近のトイレを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: We won't enter the maintenance path; we'll return the same way. I'd like to use a restroom before we leave. Is there one near the entrance?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm you'll avoid the maintenance path and return the same way, and ask about a restroom near the entrance. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 入口の右手にあります。池から戻る道を進むと案内表示が見えます。飲み水はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: It's on the right side of the entrance. You'll see signs as you follow the path back from the pond. Do you have drinking water?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 水を二本持っています。花壇で様子を見て、無理そうなら池まで行かずに入口へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 飲み水の所持を伝え花壇で父の状態を見て必要なら池を諦め戻ると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: We have two bottles of water. We'll see how my father is doing at the flower bed. If continuing seems too hard, we'll return to the entrance without going to the pond.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have drinking water and will check your father's condition at the flower bed, giving up on the pond and returning if needed. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それがよさそうですね。案内図をお持ちください。お父様とご無理のない範囲でどうぞ。それでは、よいお散歩を。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34211-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: That sounds sensible. Please take a map. Enjoy your walk with your father at a comfortable pace. Have a lovely walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その経路案内について、確認されたいところがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything about that route information you'd like to check?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 乗り換えが四分しかありません。駅に慣れていないので、間に合うか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 四分しかない接続と初めての駅への不安を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: There's only four minutes to transfer. I'm unfamiliar with the station, so I'm worried I won't make it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Express concern about a connection of only four minutes and using the station for the first time. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 初めてだと移動に時間がかかるかもしれません。何時までに着く必要がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: It may take you longer to get around on your first visit. What time do you need to arrive by?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 面接は午後二時です。昼食の時間を減らせば、少し遅い便でも大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 面接時刻と昼食時間を調整できる条件を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: My interview is at two in the afternoon. A slightly later train is okay if I shorten my lunch break.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give your interview time and explain you can adjust your lunch time. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この時刻表では、一つ後の列車で一時に着き、乗り換えも二十分あります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: According to this timetable, the next train gets you there at one, and you have twenty minutes to transfer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: その列車を選びます。乗り換える駅では、改札を出るのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 遅い便を選び改札を出る必要を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll choose that train. Do I need to leave the ticket gates at the transfer station?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the later train and ask whether you need to go out through the ticket gates. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この経路は改札内で乗り換えます。通路に上がり、案内板で次のホームを確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: On this route, you transfer within the gates. Go up to the passage and check the signs for your next platform.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 改札を出ずに通路へ上がるのですね。行き先が似た列車は、どう見分ければいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 改札内の移動を確認し似た行き先の見分け方を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: So I go up to the passage without leaving the gates. How can I distinguish trains with similar destinations?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm you'll move within the gates and ask how to distinguish similar destinations. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 発車時刻もこの紙と照らし合わせてください。不明なら、乗る前にホームの係員へ尋ねましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also match the departure time against this paper. If you're unsure, ask platform staff before boarding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 発車時刻も確認します。迷ったら紙を見せて、乗る前に係員に尋ねます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 発車時刻を確認し乗車前に係員へ尋ねると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the departure time too. If I'm unsure, I'll show the paper and ask staff before boarding.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to check the departure time and ask staff before boarding. Speak in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それで確認できますね。面接に向けて落ち着いてお出かけください。いってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-34212-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: That will let you check it. Take your time and set off calmly for your interview. Have a good journey.
